proposals.evidence: DEDR3805 explicitly gives Kurux pairī morning and pahpahrnā to dawn. Survey pɔīrī retains the diphthong with a more rounded first component; this is a same-language comparative proposal. The longer pāīrī-bīrī response is excluded pending analysis of its second member. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
